d:
Updated version made using the higher resolution pages coming from the latest release of this work.
Since the english release (done by the author) had pretty rough grammar and editing, I remastered the whole thing in order to make it more in line with this serie's other chapters.
I kept most of the original text intact, with minor edits to make them flow better and iron out the bad grammar.

I'm also labeling this as rough translation as the author claimed to have used MTL for this work's english translation.
